title: Which Planet Has the Shortest Day?
description:
Which planet spins through a full day in under ten hours? Jupiter.

It spins through a full rotation in just 9.9 hours. This extreme rotational speed generates huge centrifugal forces, flattening the poles and creating a distinct equatorial bulge.
